description: Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); EPA Office of Water. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program provides water utilities with technical assistance to prepare for the effects of global climate change. In addition, the program provides water utility owners and operators with tools and resources to support climate mitigation and adaptation approaches. Coverage: the United States (2009). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
